instruction: Send the following phone message to my parents and siblings, who do not have a venmo account, "Please get on venmo.".
notes: The set of parents/siblings and their Venmo status are only known at runtime, so the problem uses a representative instance: two parents and two siblings (declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task's precondition can mirror the goal), where parent-2 and sibling-2 are modeled as already having Venmo accounts (static init fact has-venmo-account) and therefore must be checked but not messaged. At runtime the agent instantiates one person object per contact returned by phone.search_contacts(relationship=parents|siblings), calls venmo.show_profile(email=contact.email) for each, and treats a response containing message 'Account for this email does not exist.' as (not (has-venmo-account p)); only those contacts receive the text 'Please get on venmo.'. Knowledge flow: supervisor.show_profile gives the phone username (phone_number) and venmo username (email); show_account_passwords gives passwords; search_contacts per relationship reveals emails/phone numbers (contacts-searched gate); venmo-show-profile asserts venmo-checked; phone-send-text-message requires venmo-checked and no account. Venmo login is done once (the reference re-logs in per contact, which is unnecessary). Goal requires every relative to be checked and every no-account relative to be messaged exactly once, matching the evaluation's added GlobalTextMessage receiver set and message text.
